market.rules_primary: If the Carbon Arc Streaming app downloads array index (October 2026) for October 2026 is above 80, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the Carbon Arc Streaming Apps Array value for the full month covered by this market, as recorded by Kalshi at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 7th calendar day after the end of that month. For example, the value for August is recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 7th. Later corrections or revisions will not affect the recorded value.

The reference is Carbon Arc's published full-month Streaming Apps Array level: https://www.carbonarc.co/prisms?prism=4a5e14d8-0a48-449b-9733-5fadf6a45851&entity=Streaming+Apps. The underlying metric is app downloads. The array is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of its constituent year-over-year indices. At listing, its members are Netflix, Hulu: Stream shows & movies, Disney+, Paramount+, Peacock TV: Stream TV & Movies, Max: Stream HBO, TV, & Movies, ESPN: Live Sports & Scores, each weighted 1/7. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured app downloads equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.
